verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own pages describe bizfile Online as the portal to file, search, and order business records. They state that over 140 business filings, name reservations, and certificate orders for corporations, LLCs, and LPs are available online, with expedited online service tiers and online Statement of Information filing. The User Access requirement starting August 2026 adds an account step but keeps filing online. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that formation/registration filings themselves (not just copies) are submitted online, independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed online filing and payment.
